Business Development Manager Cross Markets (Brazil)

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below, risk.lexisnexis.com

About our Team

Are you looking to join an industry-leading sales organisation? Our sales team is dedicated to partnering with organisations to address and solve complex risk problems. At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, we pride ourselves in providing solutions that directly impact our customers' ability to mitigate and manage risk.

About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for achieving revenue targets and driving business growth through effective sales strategies, in collaboration with a Field Account Manager and Overlay Sales Specialists. You’ll be responsible for the creation of a sales strategy that will build pipeline and drive incremental growth while retaining an existing book of accounts. You will prospect within your assigned territory to develop a robust pipeline, manage territory business plans, and guide prospects through the sales cycle to contract and close while maintaining the ongoing relationship for retention, upsell/cross sell and strategic relationship management.

Responsibilities

• Achieving revenue targets and drive business growth through effective sales strategies.

• Converting leads to opportunities, ensuring timely and accurate maintenance of accounts.

• Logging customer activity and communications comprehensively within the CRM system.

• Submitting monthly forecast reports and regularly update the sales pipeline.

• Prospecting within the assigned territory to develop and sustain a robust pipeline.

• Developing and manage territory business plans that include new logos, cross-selling, upselling, and renewal opportunities.

• Guiding prospects through the sales cycle to contract and close, collaborating with presales and specialist teams as needed.

• Supporting customers through onboarding and implementation phases, in partnership with the Field Account Manager, ensuring a seamless transition and ongoing revenue life cycle management.

Requirements

• Able to demonstrate experience in business development and account management.

• Prove proficiency in CRM systems, particularly Salesforce.

• Have excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

• Able to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Display analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Have a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing new business opportunities.

  9. Monitorar as gravações das câmeras de segurança para tratativas;
  10. Acompanhar as retiradas de dinheiro nos caixas e o fechamento dos mesmos no fim do expediente;
  11. Verificar itens e cupons fiscais cancelados nos caixas;

  • Para identificar qualquer problema fora dos testes e acionar o processo de solução de problemas através do JIRA Para rastrear o status de todos os problemas do JIRA
  • Fornecer uma avaliação técnica de risco, caso o problema não possa ser resolvido e um desvio precise ser levantado.

  • Cooperar com o departamento de Atributos para a definição e atualização de padrões de testes
  • Garantir um aumento robusto na operação das novas instalações implementadas

Habilidade, experiência:

  • Experiência robusta com instrumentação de veículos para testes.
  • Conhecimento profundo de procedimentos e ciclos de testes de autonomia e eficiência, com experiência comprovada em Coast Down (teste de resistência ao rolamento) e otimização do consumo de energia.

title: Banco de Talentos
description:
O Grupo Mult é um dos maiores grupos na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.
Buscamos e valorizamos talentos, pessoas com personalidade, força de vontade e determinação.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Este banco de talentos é destinado a candidatos que desejam fazer parte do nosso time, mas ainda não encontraram uma vaga ideal. Esperamos poder direcioná-lo para alguma oportunidade em breve.

Como funciona o nosso fluxo:

  1. Quando surgir uma vaga na sua cidade, buscaremos em nosso Banco de Talentos por candidatos compatíveis com o perfil desejado.
  2. Se você atender aos requisitos, entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para convidá-lo a participar do processo seletivo.
  3. Fique atento às notificações e ao seu e-mail.

Seguimos as determinações da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Portanto, só poderemos movimentar seu cadastro entre as vagas se você autorizar, no seu cadastro, o armazenamento do seu currículo por tempo indeterminado.

O cadastro no Banco de Talentos não garante uma avaliação ou oportunidade imediata. Entraremos em contato quando houver uma vaga que corresponda ao seu perfil.

História do Grupo Mult

A trajetória do Grupo Mult começou com Maxwell Lage, que em julho de 1993 abriu uma revenda de automóveis multimarcas em Governador Valadares (MG). Com o tempo, a empresa se consolidou como uma das maiores na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.

Para conhecer melhor essa evolução, confira a linha do tempo a seguir:

  1. 1993: Fundação em Governador Valadares (MG). Rápido crescimento, com filiais em Caratinga, Ipatinga e Teófilo Otoni.
  2. 2004: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Mitsubishi Motors e expandiu suas operações para outras cidades de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo.
  3. 2012: Inauguração da Kobe Nissan, tornando-se referência nacional e recebendo a honraria Revenda Samurai.
  4. 2020: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Renault em Governador Valadares.
  5. 2021: Inauguração da Multicar Mega Store em Vitória (ES) e conquista da concessão da Royal Enfield.
  6. Hoje: Com 16 lojas, incluindo unidades Nissan, Mitsubishi, Renault, Royal Enfield e uma loja de carros esportivos, além de atuar nos setores imobiliário, de seguros e veículos por assinatura.

Overview

At Powerback, we're on a mission to improve lives. As the leader in physical, occupational, speech, and respiratory therapies, we help older adults stay active and thrive while providing essential therapy for children at home and in school.


With over 38 years of trusted service, our reach spans skilled nursing centers, assisted and independent living facilities, outpatient clinics, and home-based care. We're proud to deliver personalized care exactly where and when it's needed most.


Join an industry-leading team that restores hope and makes a lasting impact. If you're passionate about making a meaningful difference and want to be part of the future of rehabilitation and wellness, Powerback is the place for you.


Why Powerback?

  • Benefits: We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to Full-Time and Part-Time team members.
  • Support for New Grads & Clinical Fellows: Our Powerback Clinical Mentorship Program kicks off on day one, helping you learn from the best in the field.
  • Continuing Education: Keep growing with free CEUs through Medbridge.
  • H-1B Visa & Relocation Assistance: We support Visa or Green Card sponsorships, plus our Journey Travel Program lets you work across the U.S. with the security of a full-time role.
  • Perks at Powerback: Enjoy exclusive discounts on Wireless/TV, Home/Auto/Renters and Pet Insurance, Childcare, Eldercare, and more. Earn rewards through our PowerZone Employee Recognition Program, and expand your expertise with our Clinicians in Action professional development program.


Responsibilities

Title: Occupational Therapy Assistant
Location/work environment: In facility
Reporting structure: Reporting to Director of Rehab


As an Occupational Therapy Assistant, you help patients get well. You are the person who can bring their power back. In doing this, you will implement occupational therapy programs and activities, follow developed recovery plans, and deliver therapy treatments.

You're a healer and a helper, which is why you got into this line of work.

You're equally adept at addressing the whole patient and seeing them as an individual. You know your goal is to execute a program that will restore, reinforce, and enhance their physical abilities and independence.

You're adaptable to the needs of the patient and can find joy in the variety of the work and the settings.

You're a teammate and are looking for collaboration with your peers, but you're also happy to make referrals to help your patient get the care they need to thrive.

You know that being an Occupational Therapy Assistant means putting patients first; ensuring patients and their families receive the highest quality of service in a caring and compassionate atmosphere.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you!


Powerback Rehabilitation (Powerback) is a new way of delivering recovery, rehabilitation, respiratory, and wellness services to patients across the nation. We deliver an empowered approach to achieving your full potential by providing integrated and individualized solutions. Our reimagined approach to rehabilitation connects directly to the patient experience, which is centered on transforming the road to recovery for everyone and helping patients get their power back. It's patient-centered care that provides a sustainable way of feeling better, moving better, breathing better, and living better.


Working in a company that values growth and understands what it means to be a caregiver is refreshing. Our CEO is a former staff therapist. We offer growth, paths forward, and we are committed to patient-centered care. We are growing, stable, and need people like you, who have a calling to help people thrive.

Isn't it time for you to work with a team where 86% of them know and feel their work makes a difference? So much so, we're certified as a 2023 Great Place to Work.

Now is the time for you to join Powerback.


Powerback has streamlined our hiring process:

1. Applying takes 3 minutes, give or take.
2. You'll hear back from us within 1 business day.
3. If you meet the qualifications, a recruiter will call you for a 10-minute conversation within 2-3 business days, depending on your availability.
4. You will then be presented to the hiring manager.
5. The hiring manager will reach out within a business day to schedule the interview.


This all happens within 1-5 business days from the phone screen.

6. After your interview, the hiring manager makes a quick decision. We aim to accomplish this within the week.
7. If the hiring manager wants to move forward, you will hear from us within a business day, because we are excited to get you started!


Qualifications

1. Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant Program according to AOTA & ACOTE standards.
2. Initial certification obtained from the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy.
3. They must be licensed and/or eligible for licensure as required in the state of practice.

The successful candidate possesses a track record of successful implementation and execution of inventory management practices, leveraging strong analytical acumen and working with cross-functional teams. The position requires an individual who can work autonomously in a highly demanding and often ambiguous environment, with strong attention to detail. The candidate should be able to manage multiple vendors simultaneously and make sure items are always available to our customers in Brazil. This role is located in São Paulo, Brazil.


At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we engage in and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of 'Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer.' Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that 'Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility.' Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon 'It’s always Day 1.' Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.


Key job responsibilities

Inventory & Supply Chain Management:

  1. Manage the supply chain to guarantee an efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows among: forecasting, purchasing, and solving receipts problems
  2. Work with vendors to ensure a reliable and operationally effective flow of goods
  3. Deliver maximum available selection in the category
  4. Design seasonal and promotional inventory preparation plan
  5. Control budgets and deliver actions to meet inventory targets
  6. Execute action plans to reduce return/liquidation costs

Operational Efficiency:

  1. Measure and improve purchasing lead times, reduce operational defects, and improve systems to streamline operations between vendors and Amazon
  2. Perform root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and manage improvements

Project Management:

  1. Work with internal teams to drive system, tools and process improvements/implementation that affect purchasing and vendor management workflow, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually
  2. Develop analysis of key business metrics, with emphasis on developing and executing recommendations for improvement
  3. Lead projects from initial development to implementation that will streamline supply systems and processes and drive operational improvements.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Advanced English Proficiency
- Experience in product/category management or commercial planning.
- Experience in logistics, supply chain and/or supply management

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of the principles of statistical inventory control
- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
- Proficiency in SQL and database concepts

Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados. O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas. Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

The Security Manager will be responsible for implementing and overseeing security operationsfor the Mexicali, MX site, ensuring a safe and secure environment for employees, assets, and business operations. The role involves risk assessment, regulatory compliance, executive protection, investigations, emergency response, vendor management, and cross-functional collaboration. The Security Manager will report to the Global Security Director and work closely with site leadership, HR, Legal, EHS, and government agencies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, enforce, and continuously improve security strategies to protect employees, facilities, and company assets.

• Conduct risk assessments, identify threats, and implement mitigation measures to reduce security vulnerabilities across all three sites.

• Manage 24/7 security operations, ensuring effective deployment of security personnel and technology.

• Oversee and maintain CCTV, access control, perimeter security, and alarm systems to prevent unauthorized access or incidents.

• Supervise third-party security vendors, ensuring compliance with company policies, performance benchmarks, and contract requirements.

• Ensure the operational readiness and maintenance of all security infrastructure and recommend technology upgrades to enhance site security.

• Support liaison efforts with law enforcement, government agencies (PNP, NBI, Customs, AHJ), and regulatory bodies to assist with security initiatives and compliance requirements.

• Ensure compliance with C-TPAT and global supply chain security standards, conducting internal audits, customer security walkthroughs, and risk mitigation planning.

• Lead and coordinate security investigations related to theft, fraud, workplace violence, and operational breaches, collaborating with HR and Legal as necessary.

• Develop, implement, and test emergency response protocols for incidents such as fire, natural disasters, active shooter situations, and civil unrest.

• Conduct security drills and training programs to ensure crisis preparedness across all sites.

• Act as the point of contact for emergency coordination and escalation.

• Oversee executive protection programs for senior leaders and high-risk personnel as required, ensuring proper security planning and travel risk assessments.

• Support security awareness initiatives and training programs for employees and security personnel to strengthen internal security culture and vigilance.

• Provide on-call emergency response support and travel between sites as needed to coordinate security operations effectively.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Security Management, Criminology, Law Enforcement, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in corporate security, law enforcement, military, or a similar field.

• Strong expertise in risk management, security investigations, executive protection, and emergency response planning.

• Experience in C-TPAT compliance, security audits, and customer security support is highly preferred.

• Proven ability to liaise with law enforcement, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.

• Strong knowledge of security technology solutions, including CCTV, access control, and alarm systems.

• Ability to travel between Laguna, Cavite, and Eastwood sites and provide on-call emergency response support.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Office-based role with frequent on-site security inspections.

• Expected to be on-call 24/7 for emergencies, crisis response, and executive protection support.

• Regular coordination with senior management, local law enforcement, and government agencies.

title: Procurement and Logistics Associate
description:
Program Overview : Chemonics International, a US-based international development consulting firm, seeks a Procurement and Logistics Specialist for the USAID Iraq Together project. Iraq Together aims to provide more equitable, efficient, and sustainable public services in Iraq, as well as improving government responsiveness to citizens’ needs and demands. Objectives of this project include working with the Government of Iraq (GOI) to improve service delivery and strengthen democratic and participatory governance.

Position Overview: The Procurement and Logistics Associate will be responsible for leading the technical and operational procurement processes on Iraq Together, in coordination with the Operations Director and their team. The individual will ensure quality standards are met, and all procurements are cost-effective and compliant with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, and Iraqi government laws. This role will oversee the full procurement cycle, including support to the program teams as required, and lead the logistical operations of the project activities and office facilities. This position is open to Iraqi nationals residing in Baghdad, Iraq.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Preserve the integrity of the procurement process, including drafting project procurement documents including all solicitations, negotiation memos, consents to subcontract, and applicable waivers.
  • Maintain organized and concise procurement files that document project compliance with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, as well as local, third country, or US government rules that affect the procurement process.
  • Provide guidance to technical and operational staff on procurement/compliance policies, in particular those contained in FAR, CFR, ADS, and AIDAR regulating procurement.
  • Enforce clear and transparent procurement procedures.
  • Work directly with local, regional, or international vendors and service providers to obtain quotations and/or to conduct procurements of commodities or services.
  • Monitor contracts and purchase orders and conduct follow-up as necessary to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.
  • Compile all required documentation to facilitate payment requests.
  • Organize and participate in internal evaluation committees.
  • Monitor for any procurement-related conflict of interest and ensure the project’s procurement process is open and transparent.
  • Work with project leadership to answer any questions or provide USAID with any requested information about project procurements.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of procurement, subcontracts and grants required.
  • Experience working for USAID or other donor funded projects strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience and understanding of procurement procedures of international organizations.
  • Strong organizational, management, and administrative skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work efficiently and respectfully with a diverse group of people.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated leadership, versatility, and integrity.
  • Proficiency in written and oral Arabic and English is required; written and oral fluency in Kurdish, and other local languages is a plus, but not required.

Na saída da garagem, retirar a FCV e selo de vistoria no setor de tráfego; Conferir se o Check List está no interior do veículo; Realizar vistoria do veículo conforme Check List, anotar / conferir numeração do hodômetro no Check List, sessão aberta e acionamento de campainhas;

Realizar o transporte de passageiros adequadamente, prezando pela direção defensiva, segurança dos passageiros, pedestres e demais pessoas envolvidas no trânsito, seguir corretamente itinerário definido; Atender as regras da empresa, da gerenciadora de transporte público e legislação de trânsito vigente; Acatar e atender as solicitações determinadas pela fiscalização/operação; Cumprir os horários determinados pela gerenciadora de transporte; Atender aos itens relacionados a regime de escalas conforme contrato de trabalho; Seguir horários de trabalhos conforme necessidade da empresa, atendendo a convenção coletiva de trabalho vigente; Em caso de acidente, se houver vítimas, prestar socorro ligando para as autoridades competentes de emergência, conforme números informados no verso do Check List; Preencher informações estabelecidas no Check List/Relatório de Ocorrência, conforme procedimento interno; O motorista que trabalhar em linha e horário sem a presença do cobrador deverá cobrar tarifas, de acordo com o valor estabelecido, oferecendo o troco pontualmente de forma correta; Preencher ficha com o número de passageiros (conforme catraca), de acordo com horários estabelecidos na FVC nos pontos de regulagem; Abrir sessão e fechar a mesma, coletando todas as informações do número de passageiros pagantes, isentos, estudantes; Transferir informações coletadas para o sistema SBE (Sistema de Bilhetagem Eletrônica); Gerar extrato e realizar o acerto de valores arrecadados diariamente; Realizar o acerto (de todas as suas jornadas), conforme estabelecido pelo procedimento, não podendo realizar o acerto duplo, nem no dia seguinte; Deverá ser colocado o dinheiro arrecadado no malote, juntamente com o extrato e depositar na boca de lobo; Verificar diariamente edital no setor de arrecadação, de pendências ou sobras de valores arrecadados; Atender aos convites para treinamento e palestras, ou apresentar justificativa legal, caso não haja comparecimento.

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. *Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our Data Solutions squad in Brazil !

Join our growing Data team at Wellhub and contribute to our data democratization mission: make data accessible to everyone! We are responsible for empowering all teams by providing a scalable and reliable data platform to collect, organize, and process the deluge of data generated daily at Wellhub, following data modeling and governance best practices. Your work will directly impact our goal of enabling all teams to make data-driven decisions and generate business value from data.

We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running Kubernetes, Trino, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Flink, and more cutting-edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Design and implement innovative data solutions that enhance automation, efficiency, and productivity for data practitioners across the organization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop in-house data solutions that meet organizational needs.
  • Lead the evaluation and integration of cutting-edge technologies to optimize our data and machine learning processes.
  • Ensure robust data architecture and technical product integration, enhancing the overall data ecosystem.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Hands-on expertise in data engineering and architecture, with the ability to follow software engineering best practices.
  • Experience in building in-house solutions to address common data engineering patterns.
  • Proficient in CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes.

O Coordenador Financeiro trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas da empresa, como RH, Comercial e Operações (logística, estoque, obras, sustentação TI e manutenção), para garantir que as decisões financeiras estejam alinhadas com os objetivos da organização como um todo.

  • Gestão de Equipe: Coordenar e liderar a equipe financeira, promovendo o desenvolvimento e a capacitação dos colaboradores, comunicação impessoal com o time.

  • Análise de Conciliação Bancária: Analisar a conciliação entre os registros bancários e contábeis, assegurando que os dados estejam corretos e atualizados.
  • Planejamento Orçamentário: Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, alinhando as metas financeiras com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Análise Financeira: Realizar análises financeiras para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas, como relatórios de contas a receber, liberações de POS, Mobpin e TEF e viabilidade de projetos.
  • Gestão de Custos e ferramentas de estratégias de negócio: Acompanhar e identificar oportunidades para redução de custos, buscando sempre otimizar os gastos da organização. Auxiliar na gestão do fundo de investimento.
  • Compliance e Obrigações Fiscais: Garantir que a empresa cumpra todas as obrigações fiscais e tributárias, evitando multas e problemas com órgãos reguladores.

Formação acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças ou Gestão Empresarial pode ser um diferencial.

Olha só quais experiências e habilidades precisamos que você possua:

  • Experiência: Experiência prévia na área financeira, com pelo menos experiência de vivência em cargos de liderança.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento avançado em Excel, sistemas ERP (SAP), análise de relatórios financeiros, planejamento orçamentário.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Boa capacidade de liderança, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisões, organização, proatividade e visão estratégica.

Porque vir para Gentil:

Juntos vamos cumprir o nosso propósito de inspirar pessoas que trabalho e empreendedorismo geram prosperidade e transformam realidades. Na Gentil Negócios, o seu protagonismo faz acontecer!

title: Client Advocate - Commercial Insurance (Retail and Distribution)
description:
Description

The Client Advocate is responsible for maintaining and cultivating client relationships. The Client Advocate role has a strong connection to the client’s business and a fundamental understanding of its industry. The Client Advocatecontributes to and generates new opportunities with prospects by developing and closing on expanded business services, products and solutions with existing clients. Client Advocates drive the RFP response process including coordination of key internal stakeholders, work in conjunction with the RFP team on the overall response presentation and participate in or lead the oral presentation.As a Client Advocate are responsible with developing innovative solutions. Client facing responsibilities expected to be 90%.

A Client Advocate (CA) will need to have:

  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Strong management skills (mentoring and leading ACAs)
  • Strong project management skills
  • Strong presentation skills
  • An advocate for change

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.
The Role

As a senior member of the organization, you will have additional responsibility serving as:

  • A mentor to colleagues
  • A Subject Matter Expert for one or more lines of business and/or Industry Vertical and/or
  • A Team Leader
  • Contributes to new business opportunities for new clients and develops business opportunities with existing clients
  • Drives the RFP response process, including review, identification, and coordination of resources and expertise required, and ultimate document ownership
  • Engages with sales and broking to understand marketplace changes
  • Retains existing book of business and develop and strengthen client relationships – recognized as primary client relationship contact
  • Establishes comprehensive understanding of client’s industry, business, and objectives
  • Provides strategic planning and consulting advice to clients; monitors insurance and risk management needs in collaboration with WTW resource, practice, and industry groups. Recommends appropriate solutions throughout the policy term (including acquisition due diligence)
  • Drives creation and delivery of E365 Plan and Client Stewardship report
  • Identifies, engages, and integrates delivery of all WTW internal resources to deliver on the client experience
  • Leads and mentors account team members
  • Maximizes the profitability and retention of their book of business
  • Negotiates, creates, and delivers fee/compensation agreements to clients
  • Informs client’s insurance program design and strategy by working in conjunction with Broking to ensure utilization of appropriate analytical tools
  • Drives design and delivery of client presentations/proposals, client advocacy reports, client service plans and schedules
  • Drives the renewal process to establish and implement the client-specific renewal strategy. Collaborates with WTW resource, practice, and industry groups to develop and deliver renewal to clients.
  • Ensures Group policy requirements (legal, regulatory & compliance) are met
  • Other duties as identified and appropriate to ensure exceptional client experience

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • Targeted 8+ years of commercial Property & Casualty experience in a client facing role or demonstrated capabilities to complete role responsibilities
  • Able to apply knowledge of coverage forms in the analysis of program design, the identification of coverage gaps, and ongoing coverage consultation
  • Ability to interpret, analyze, and present analytical models
  • Relationship Management skills: able to leverage internal and external relationships to bring WTW resources and assets tailored to client needs; ability to drive conflict resolution
  • Negotiation skills: Ability to develop innovative and creative solutions to do complex deals, drive consensus across internal and external stakeholders to close deals and theability to drive conflict resolution and secure concessions mitigating injury to client relationships
  • Business Acumen; knowledge of strategy, tactics, and solutions for the client, and/or in the marketplace
  • Knowledge of commercial insurance renewal end-to-end process, steps and owners
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; group presentation skills, ability to drive complex/technical conversations
  • Excellent project management skills: end-to-end oversight of large, complex, ambiguous, or multi-dimensional projects
  • Effectively advocates for change. Provides encouragement, takes control of team projects, leads key work areas, collaborates with others, provides clear guidance to ensure others fulfill roles effectively
  • Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills, high adaptability
  • Intellectual curiosity to help develop innovative and creative ideas
  • Proficient Microsoft Office skills and familiarity with other relevant online tools
  • Must achieve and maintain insurance brokers P&C license and complete various continuing education activities as needed
  • Insurance industry designations preferred but not required (CPCU, ARM, CIC, CRIS, CRM)

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $120,000-$140,000 USDper year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (Washington State only )
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k).

EOE, including disability/vets

You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Manager, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.
Key job responsibilities
Your core activities and responsibilities include:
- being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
- leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
- leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
- owning and managing change on a granular level;
- performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
- work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
- make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.
A day in the life
You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:
- FC Ops;
- Middle Mile and Last Mile teams;
- Learning;
- Finance;
- HR;
- Loss Prevention.
You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.
About the team
The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree.
- Experience with program or project management;
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams;
- Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics;
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL;
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
- Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus);
- Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience;
- Experience driving complex process improvements;
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization;
- Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
- Black Belt certification

Analista Técnico de Manutenção de Frota Sr (Frota Pesada) - RP 16546 - Sistema Fiep (Fiep, Sesi, Senai e IEL).

title: Digital System Architech  (d / f / m)
description:
People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, we care about the safety of others and we share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility.

We are seeking a Digital Solutions System Architect to lead the high-level design and technical direction of our global elevator digital solutions. This role will oversee the architecture of embedded systems, IoT solutions, and connectivity platforms, ensuring seamless integration, security, and scalability across our next-generation elevator technology. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining best practices, making key technology decisions, and acting as a technical liaison between teams to drive innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • High-Level System Design: Define the architectural vision and technical roadmap for IoT-enabled digital elevator solutions, ensuring alignment with business and security requirements.
  • Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor development teams in implementing robust, scalable, and maintainable digital solutions.
  • System Architecture Modeling: Create and maintain UML diagrams, system models, and technical documentation to ensure clarity and consistency in system design.
  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve technical challenges, ensuring reliability and performance of digital elevator solutions.
  • Technology & Tooling Decisions: Select appropriate development platforms, frameworks, tools, and environments for digital projects.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a technical liaison between embedded software teams, security teams, cloud infrastructure teams, and external partners.
  • Security & Compliance: Work closely with security specialists to integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Performance Optimization: Ensure that all software and system designs are optimized for performance, efficiency, and scalability.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with exceptional GPA.

Experience:

  • 5-7 years experience with computer science or software engineering related project work in embedded development (preferably in projects involving complex systems similar to elevator and escalators).

Technical Skills:

  • Outstanding programming skills with expertise in one or more languages: C, C++, C#, Java, Python.
  • Deep knowledge of UML and system modeling methodologies.
  • Strong background in embedded systems, IoT protocols, and cloud integration.
  • Experience with cybersecurity principles, secure development lifecycle, and compliance standards.
  • Knowledge of real-time operating systems (RTOS), Linux embedded, and microcontroller architectures.
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, RS485, MQTT, and industrial IoT standards.
  • Strong understanding of linear algebra, discrete mathematics, calculus, and statistics.
  • Experience with hardware development and manufacturing processes are desired.
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and automation frameworks is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Outstanding creative thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, able to convey complex ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exceptional leadership with a collaborative, upbeat personality.
  • Ability to work in a global, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.

Language:

  • Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional languages, such as German and/or Spanish, are beneficial.

TK Elevator prides itself on being an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or age.

title: FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fullfillment by Amazon
description:
FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fulfillment by Amazon

At Amazon Brazil we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions, therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Understanding our responsibility and our need for change is essential.


Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s Brazil team! Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries list their products for sale on Amazon. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.


We are looking for a Program Manager for Amazon to support FBA (Fulfillment By Amazon) Brazil. This position will be based in an Amazon FC and will support the FBA team to manage its operations. This PM will work closely with various stakeholders (Operations, S&OP, Program, Sales, Operations, Transportation, Legal, etc.) to drive strategic and tactical initiatives to improve FBA operations, including Inbound, Outbound, and Inventory Management. This position will focus on process improvements across teams, identifying areas of opportunities, mapping processes, and proposing optimizations, as well as managing daily operations. He/She will build and own metrics and reports and review performance metrics, being the bridge between FC operations and Business teams.


Key Job Responsibilities

The key responsibilities for this role include:

  1. Act as the link between FC Operations and FBA Business teams
  2. Identify gaps, pain points, and opportunities in the existing processes and propose improvements
  3. Dive Deep on issues to differentiate isolated issues from structural ones
  4. Own metrics and reports, as well as keeping track of key metrics and initiatives impact
  5. Be creative to create solutions that address pain points/opportunities and improve Seller Experience
  6. Calculate impact/potential of ideas/pain points, making it tangible
  7. Influence and support the Product team (both Latam and global teams) on Roadmap prioritization
  8. Suggest/create programmatic solutions and initiatives while creating business cases for the Product team
  9. Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints

About the Team

FBA is one key team in Amazon BR. We manage the operations for sellers that send their inventory to our Fulfillment Center (FC) - from collecting their products to delivering them to customers and receiving customers' returns. In FBA, we have several teams that manage SX and operations in this business model. Fulfillment Operations is one of the teams, and we manage the whole inventory once it's received in the FC: Inventory management, removals, customer returns, reimbursements, and operational processes. We are a data-driven team that owns metrics tracking and evolution, maps gaps, and implements improvements to impact our sellers and customers.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of driving end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: AUXILIAR OPERACIONAL - CD - LEO MADEIRAS Barueri - SP Full-time employee
description:
Você busca um lugar para aprender e contribuir? Venha fazer parte do time Leo Madeiras.

A Leo Madeiras é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos e serviços para marcenaria do Brasil, que valoriza as pessoas e oferece oportunidades de aprendizado. Para nós, o mais importante é que seu perfil esteja alinhado aos nossos princípios e cultura.

Estamos em busca de um talento que gostaria de nos ajudar na nossa missão e jornada, se identificou? Venha Ser Leo!

Responsabilidades:

  1. Executar a armazenagem das linhas de produtos de madeiras comercializados pela Rede Leo, conforme políticas e procedimentos internos da organização, etiquetando-os e alocando-os nas gôndolas pré-definidas e identificadas no Centro de Distribuição (CD).
  2. Manter a organização e limpeza dos produtos do setor que atua, recolhendo as embalagens e pontaletes dos pallets e os descartando nos locais apropriados para reciclagem de lixo, bem como solicitando à equipe de serviços gerais o recolhimento dos lixos e lavagem dos setores.
  3. Separar os produtos de acordo com os espelhos de notas fiscais (quantidade, modelo e cores), montando fardos dentro dos limites definidos pelos fabricantes e embalando-os adequadamente para expedição.
  4. Conferir os pedidos separados comparando-os com as solicitações dos espelhos de notas fiscais, avaliando a qualidade dos produtos (riscos, quebra, torto, etc.), reduzindo o envio de produtos danificados ou faltantes para os clientes.
  5. Participar do Programa 5S, praticando os mandamentos destes em sua rotina de trabalho (utilidade, arrumação, limpeza, asseio pessoal, autodisciplina).

Requisitos:

  • Experiência na função;
  • Fácil acesso a Baueri.

Benefícios:

  • Refeição no Local
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia: Para cuidados com a saúde, facilitando a compra de medicamentos em farmácias em todo o Brasil
  • Gympass: Para você treinar em diversas academias, realizar esportes e aulas
  • Seguro de vida: Para a sua segurança e de sua família
  • Cursos em nossa plataforma interna: Para apoiá-lo em seu processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

Fundada em 1943, a Leo evoluiu de uma loja na Rua do Gasômetro para a maior distribuidora de produtos e serviços para marcenaria do Brasil, dispondo do maior estoque e variedade do setor, com mais de 15.000 itens ofertados.

Hoje conta com mais de 110 lojas distribuídas em diversos estados brasileiros, além de um Centro de Distribuição e sede administrativa em Barueri - SP. Todas as lojas estão localizadas em pontos estratégicos como na grande São Paulo e em cidades de projeção das regiões Sudeste, Sul, Nordeste, Norte e Centro-Oeste do Brasil e também estamos presentes no Paraguai.

A filosofia de trabalho da Leo está baseada na satisfação de seus clientes. Para tanto, procura garantir qualidade dos produtos, preços competitivos e ótimo atendimento, além de praticar uma política empresarial séria e consciente, reinvestindo os resultados no próprio negócio, buscando o crescimento sustentável e continuado e assumindo um compromisso com o meio ambiente e com a sociedade.

Nossa crença está baseada no desenvolvimento profissional de nossos clientes, na valorização das pessoas, no crescimento de nosso negócio e no respeito ao meio ambiente e à sociedade. Nossa Visão e Princípios refletem nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

Contribuir para o sucesso do setor da marcenaria.

Visão

Ser reconhecida, em todo Brasil, como a "marca da marcenaria".

"Eu tenho prazer em servir. Conheço o meu cliente e antecipo suas necessidades".

Agir com Alegria e Paixão

"Eu trabalho de forma apaixonada, e assim inspiro meus colegas".

"Eu busco soluções simples e criativas para resolver problemas. Eu cumpro o combinado e o que é esperado de mim".

Trabalhar em equipe. Fazer pelo todo, com o todo.

"Eu atuo de forma colaborativa porque acredito que juntos somos mais".

A Leo valoriza as pessoas e oferece oportunidades de aprendizado, independentemente de sua condição física, mental, social, idade, etnia, identidade de gênero, credo ou orientação sexual. Para nós, o mais importante é que seu perfil esteja alinhado aos nossos princípios e cultura.

Análise do Anúncio de Emprego

O anúncio apresenta uma descrição detalhada das qualificações, habilidades e responsabilidades, além de listar requisitos mínimos, o que é positivo. No entanto, há aspectos que podem ser aprimorados para melhorar a formatação, clareza e foco do conteúdo.

Aspectos de formatação: O uso de tags HTML é adequado, mas há uma mistura de listas ordenadas e não ordenadas que poderia ser melhor organizada para facilitar a leitura.

Conteúdo: O texto é bastante extenso e contém informações relevantes, porém, algumas partes são redundantes, como a repetição de habilidades de comunicação e adaptação. Além disso, há detalhes excessivos que podem ser considerados secundários, dificultando a compreensão do perfil ideal.

Relevância e concisão: O anúncio poderia ser mais objetivo, focando nas responsabilidades principais e nos requisitos essenciais, eliminando detalhes excessivos que não agregam valor imediato à vaga.

Requisitos mínimos: Os requisitos estão bem listados, cobrindo experiência, habilidades interpessoais, e requisitos de localização, o que é adequado.

Sugestões de melhorias: Organizar as responsabilidades em categorias, reduzir redundâncias, e usar uma linguagem mais direta e estruturada para melhorar a leitura e compreensão.

Portanto, recomendo uma revisão para aprimorar a clareza e a organização do anúncio.

description:

Join to apply for the Pharmacy Technician role at CVS Health

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

At CVS Health, we’re building a world of health around every consumer and surrounding ourselves with dedicated colleagues who are passionate about transforming health care.
As the nation’s leading health solutions company, we reach millions of Americans through our local presence, digital channels and more than 300,000 purpose-driven colleagues – caring for people where, when and how they choose in a way that is uniquely more connected, more convenient and more compassionate. And we do it all with heart, each and every day.
Job Purpose And Summary
At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Pharmacy Technicians (Technicians) play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise.
As a Technician, you will support the pharmacy team in delivering operational and service excellence within your store. Technicians are often the first point of contact to assist our patients and customers to deliver an exceptional experience. Technicians assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. Technicians operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.
Once in role, Technicians are required to complete a rigorous company training program and satisfy all registration, licensing, and certification requirements according to their State’s Board of Pharmacy guidelines. Until the Pharmacy Technician has completed all necessary requirements, duties may be restricted by the Pharmacy Manager.
A Technician is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification
Where permissible, the Pharmacy Technician may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:
  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient
  • Monitoring and managing vaccine supplies
Required Qualifications
  • Must comply with any state board of pharmacy requirements or laws governing the practice of pharmacy, which includes but is not limited to, age, education, and licensure/certification
    • If the state board of pharmacy does not address or mandate a minimum age requirement, must be at least 16 years of age
    • If the state board of pharmacy does not address or mandate a minimum educational requirement, must have a high school diploma or equivalent, or be actively enrolled in high school or high school equivalency program
  • State-level licensure and national certification requirements vary by state
Essential Functions
  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:

title: ACES FC Process Specialist - Outbound, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)
description:
ACES FC Process Specialist - Outbound, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As a Process Specialist for Amazon's Fulfillment Centers, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across our FC network.
You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Specialist, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.
Key job responsibilities
Your core activities and responsibilities include:
- being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
- leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
- leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
- owning and managing change on a granular level;
- performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
- work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
- make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.
A day in the life
You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:
- FC Ops;
- Middle Mile and Last Mile teams;
- Learning;
- Finance;
- HR;
- Loss Prevention.
You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.
About the team
The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree.
- Experience with program or project management;
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams;
- Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics;
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL;
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
- Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus);
- Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience;
- Experience driving complex process improvements;
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization;
- Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
- Black Belt certification

Resumo da Vaga
O Monster Ambassador Team é um programa de marketing global da Monster Energy Company. O objetivo do programa é:

  1. Gerar experimentação/degustação de produtos Monster Energy Drink pelos consumidores.
  2. Comunicar a mensagem/pilares da Marca MEC (Monster Energy Company) estrategicamente aos consumidores. Exemplo de atuação: Esportes de ação, Automobilismo, Música e Gaming.
  3. Auxiliar na geração de leads para a divisão de vendas.
  4. Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com key accounts.
  5. Construir redes de influência na região.
  6. Apoiar os esforços de vendas por meio de sampling em eventos e merchandising (caso solicitado pelo MAT Leader).

Funções essenciais da vaga:

Os embaixadores terão várias funções e responsabilidades relacionadas ao engajamento do consumidor e merchandising, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao seguinte:

  1. Gerar ativamente a degustação de Monster Energy durante o sampling de guerrilha.
  2. Abordar consumidores que “precisam” de energia e fazer a degustação.
  3. Distribuir brindes aos consumidores para reforçar a fidelidade à marca.
  4. Executar eventos, de todos os níveis, incluindo os eventos de Base, para esportes e cultura com foco na experiência da marca. Se necessário, coordenar ativações com agências e parceiros.
  5. Desenvolver redes pessoais de relacionamentos internos e externos eficazes, incluindo Equipes de Engarrafadores do Sistema KO.
  6. Cooperar com outros membros da equipe.
  7. Acompanhar as atividades dos concorrentes da marca em campo e relatar em tempo hábil.
  8. Responsabilizar-se pelo bom uso dos materiais e recursos do programa da empresa Monster Energy.
  9. Ser pontual e cumprir o turno agendado pelo supervisor direto.
  10. Manter a aparência da marca usando uniforme adequado, mantendo hábitos de higiene de imagem pessoal conforme sugerido no manual de treinamento.
  11. Garantir profissionalismo, comunicação excepcional e interações proativas com consumidores e colegas de trabalho.
  12. Responder em tempo hábil ao MAT Leader e ao Regional MAT Manager.
  13. Pode ser necessário viajar - Caso requisitado.

Merchandising (Caso solicitado pelo MAT Leader)
• Promover produtos MEC em geladeiras e em coolers.
• Conforme designado, realizar verificações de rotina nas lojas para garantir que as gôndolas estejam abastecidas com os produtos MEC de acordo com as sugestões do MAT Leader e TDM.
• Verificar se todos os Pontos de Venda (PDV) estão positivados corretamente e com precisão ao nível da loja, incluindo; mas não limitado a preços, sinalização promocional e displays.
• Transmitir dados obtidos no mercado com MAT Leader e TDM.
• Gerenciar com responsabilidade todos os materiais e ativos do programa da Monster Energy Co.
Deve relatar quaisquer questões relacionados aos funcionários do PDV ao MAT Leader alinhado com o TDM.

Requisitos da Vaga:
• Deve ter 21 anos ou mais.
• Deve ter um registro de condução limpo.
• Deve ser capaz de levantar até 19 kg, estar fisicamente apto e ativo.
• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé por longos períodos de tempo.
• Ter um alto nível de energia com uma atitude de “consigo fazer”.
• Preocupar-se com a imagem pessoal e higiene.
• Ser socialmente responsável, extrovertido e prezar pela diversidade.
• Ter interesse em esportes de ação é um extra.
• Experiência promocional é um extra.
• Domínio fluente de inglês, espanhol ou outros idiomas é um extra.

We celebrate with our fans and riders and employees!

Nossa empresa valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão. Todas as vagas estão abertas também para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD).

Nossa marca se destaca por aplicar tecnologia de ponta no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras, sustentáveis e de alta performance, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para a sociedade.

Aqui na Onet, acreditamos que a diversidade e a pluralidade dos nossos profissionais são os alicerces da inovação, empatia e sinergia que impulsionam o desenvolvimento de soluções únicas e diferenciadas para cada cliente. Para cumprir essa missão, nossa área de Recursos Humanos é incansável. Oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento na carreira, programas de treinamento sob medida às necessidades dos clientes e um contínuo desenvolvimento do nosso capital humano.

title: Brand and Creative Designer for Frank & Myra
description:
We are seeking a talented and versatile Brand and Creative Designer to join our growing aromatherapy company, Frank & Myra. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for creating visually stunning designs that effectively communicate our brand story and values. As the lead designer, you will be responsible for developing and executing a cohesive visual identity across all touchpoints, from packaging to digital media.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and refine Frank & Myra's brand identity, including logo design, color palettes, typography, and visual guidelines.
  2. Design compelling product packaging for our line of essential oils, hydrosols, and resins that balances aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability.
  3. Create marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, catalogs, and point-of-purchase displays that engage customers and drive sales.
  4. Collaborate with the marketing team to design digital assets, including website graphics, social media visuals, email templates, and online advertisements.
  5. Produce outstanding product photography and lifestyle imagery that showcases our products and resonates with our target audience.
  6. Ensure brand consistency across all design elements and platforms, maintaining the highest standards of quality and attention to detail.
  7. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, consumer preferences, and emerging design technologies to continuously innovate and improve our visual communications.
  8. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product development, marketing, and operations, to align design strategies with business objectives and timelines.
  9. Manage relationships with external vendors, such as printers and packaging suppliers, to ensure quality control and cost-effectiveness.
  10. Provide creative direction and mentorship to junior designers or freelancers as the company grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in brand identity development and packaging design, preferably in the wellness or beauty industry.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in brand strategy, packaging design, digital media, and photography.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other relevant design software.
  • Excellent understanding of color theory, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Familiarity with printing processes, packaging materials, and sustainable design practices.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Passion for wellness, natural products, and sustainable living.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Design or a related field.
  • Experience with motion graphics, video editing, or 3D rendering.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and web design best practices.
  • Familiarity with aromatherapy, essential oils, and natural wellness products.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and desire to grow with a small, mission-driven company.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Arrangements
  • Professional Development
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Community Engagement

At Frank & Myra, we are committed to creating exceptional products that promote well-being while adhering to the highest standards of ethics and sustainability. As our Brand and Creative Designer, you will play a crucial role in shaping our visual identity and communicating our values to the world. We offer a supportive, collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and communities.

To apply, please submit your resume, portfolio, and a cover letter expressing your interest in the position and why you believe you would be a great fit for Frank & Myra. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team

Join to apply for the Operations & Technician Maintenance Union role at ALLY Energy

Calpine Corporation is America's largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal resources with operations in competitive power markets. Its fleet of 77 power plants in operation represents over 27,000 megawatts of generation capacity. Through wholesale power operations and its retail businesses, Calpine serves customers in 22 states and Canada. Its clean, efficient, modern and flexible fleet uses advanced technologies to generate power in a low-carbon and environmentally responsible manner.

The company was established on the premise that a strong commitment to the environment is inextricably linked to excellence in power generation and corporate responsibility. Since its founding in 1984, Calpine has led the power industry in its unwavering commitment to environmental stewardship. In addition, its renewable geothermal plants use steam generated deep below the earth's surface to produce clean, renewable electricity.

Job Summary

(includes but is not limited to the following, other duties may be assigned)

Responsible for the proper operation of the power facility while assigned on shift. Maintains, troubleshoots, and repairs mechanical and electrical equipment. This equipment includes, but is not limited to the Gas Turbine, Steam Turbine, HRSG, Gas Compressor, Air Compressors, Motors, Pumps, and other auxiliary equipment. Strictly adheres to all safety and environmental rules and regulations to protect employees and public safety. Works under the direction of Plant management and supervision.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible to fill in for Lead Operator on an as needed basis
  • Reads meters, gauges, or automatic devices to record data such as temperature of equipment, vibration of equipment, hours of operation, pressure, and fluid levels to verify operating conditions.
  • Keeps management, supervisors, and employees fully informed of unusual conditions, damaged equipment, and current job progress as the job relates to facility operations.
  • Visually inspects and listens to equipment at periodic intervals to detect malfunctions or need for repair, adjustment or lubrication.
  • Uses facility operating procedures and equipment technical manuals to maintain and repair facility equipment and ensure equipment is operated within operating range. Fully supports the use of a computerized Maintenance Management System by displaying a proficiency in using the system and dedication to the facility maintenance philosophy.
  • Maintains equipment by tightening fittings, replacing valve packing, gaskets, valves, and gauges. Cleaning, replacing, oiling and lubricating other component parts and equipment as required.
  • Performs the work of all equal or lesser skilled classifications. Records maintenance actions taken on Work Order forms.
  • Opens and closes valves as required for proper system operation and mechanical isolation.
  • Opens and closes circuit breakers as required for proper system operation and electrical isolation.
  • Performs capital project and/or major program responsibilities as assigned by the Plant management or supervision.
  • Repairs, replaces, dismantles and examines defective parts along with lubricating and cleaning parts.
  • Sets up and operates drill press, grinder and other various tools to make and repair parts and equipment.
  • Operates welding and cutting equipment and completes metal fabrication projects.
  • Diagnoses cause of mechanical malfunction or failure of operational equipment. Reads, understands and complies with all regulatory procedures and facility safety.
  • Work shifts as assigned or irregular hours as needed to support reliable operation of the facility. Must be available to work overtime as required.
  • Maintains the cleanliness of the assigned maintenance areas. Cooperates and participates as a team member.

Job Requirements

  • Associates Degree (AA) or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or four to six years related experience and/or training; or a combination of experience and education. Basic electrical knowledge. High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver's license
  • Demonstrate knowledge of all facets of power plant operations. Demonstrate the ability to make competent decisions in emergency situation, capable of writing operating procedures and training site personnel. Capable of filling the position of Lead Operator on shift. Demonstrate the ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and P&IDs, write routine reports, solve practical problems, make competent decisions in emergency situations, clearly communicate tasks and needs, and training of other personnel. Demonstrate good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 50 pounds), walking and stooping, wearing self-contained breathing apparatus, respirator. Must have ability to see color.
  • Employees will progress through the various steps of this classification based on their demonstrated knowledge, skills and abilities. Employees that cannot perform all the duties of the classification will be slotted in the progression at the appropriate level and pay if possible or discharged.
